items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: You said there was Charlie Barker and this Dizzy Gillespie. That is wrong in this respect.

ctx.x: Hawk took all that had been done, and not only assimilated it but built on it. Correct?

Well, I'd have to correct you on that in this sense. You said there was Charlie Barker and this Dizzy Gillespie. That is wrong in this respect. These people were inspired by Coleman Hawkins, believe it or not, and Art Tatum.
